caption:
Most shops lose trust in the gap between booking and arrival.

Here's the fix, shown as an example workflow:

1. Tech marks the job en route
2. Customer gets a text with a name, photo, and real ETA
3. Job complete triggers a payment link and review request in the same thread

No one on your team has to remember any of it. It fires on its own.

Illustrative example workflow, not a live client account.

DM SCALE

#HomeServices #ContractorLife #HVAC #FieldService #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels still lead for B2B depth and saves, and this fills the unclaimed dispatch-to-close stage (en route text through job-complete payment and review request) distinct from every prior reminder, no-show, booking, win-back, and task-escalation demonstration already shipped.
